meta.source: nflverse / nflfastR play-by-play, rosters, injuries, schedules/odds; Open-Meteo forecast weather
meta.injury_note: Current-week injury reports adjust matchup strength; reserve status prevents unavailable players from being recommended without double-counting long-term absences.
meta.weather_note: Weather adjustments use the forecast nearest kickoff for outdoor/open-roof games and are intentionally conservative.
meta.market_note: Current spread, total, implied points, moneyline and no-vig moneyline win chance are included when available. Historical ATS results are a small contextual signal, not a guarantee. Player comparison uses team/game market context; player-specific prop hit rates require a separate prop-odds source.
